theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_test_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (B : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Eucl k → ℝ) (f₀ : Eucl k → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → (∀ j, AEStronglyMeasurable (f j) ((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict Ω)) → AEStronglyMeasurable f₀ ((volume : Measure (Eucl k)).restrict Ω) → (∀ j, ∀ w ∈ Ω, |f j w| ≤ B) → (∀ w ∈ Ω, |f₀ w| ≤ B) → (∀ φ : Eucl k → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ω → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, φ w * f j w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, φ w * f₀ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))) → ∀ η : Eucl k → ℝ, IntegrableOn η Ω (volume : Measure (Eucl k)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ w in Ω, η w * f j w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ w in Ω, η w * f₀ w ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))))
